# BB-495-INFRA-UntrackOversizedCliWatchCitationsJson: Stop tracking the two oversized cli-watch citations.json reports and gitignore the pattern

**Priority:** Low
**Domain:** INFRA (dev tooling, `tooling/cli-watch/`)
**Surfaced by:** BB-414 Part B decision (`tooling/cli-watch/REPO-SPLIT-DECISION.md`)

---

## Summary

BB-414 decided cli-watch stays in this repo. The one real size problem is two report files, so stop tracking them and keep the pattern out of git.

## Problem

Measured 2026-10-07 with `ls -lS tooling/cli-watch/reports`:

| File | Size |
|---|---|
| `reports/2.1.273__2.1.274-citations.json` | 77,621,185 bytes |
| `reports/2.1.277__2.1.278-citations.json` | 35,620,253 bytes |
| Every other file in `reports/` | 117,239 bytes or smaller |

Both files are tracked (`git ls-files tooling/cli-watch/reports | grep citations.json` lists exactly these two). `git check-ignore -v` finds no rule for the pattern. Nothing in `tooling/cli-watch/cliwatch/` reads a `-citations.json` file. Item generation reads `-candidates.md` (`items.py:116`) and `-items.md` (`items.py:1849`). The `-citations.md` twins are 2.7 MB and 2.6 MB and stay tracked.

Untracking stops future growth. It does not shrink history: the outer repo packs to 69.88 MiB (`git count-objects -vH`), and removing the blobs from history needs a rewrite that this item does not propose.

## Proposed Solution

1. Run `git rm --cached` on the two `*-citations.json` paths. Keep the files on disk.
2. Add `tooling/cli-watch/reports/*-citations.json` to `.gitignore`.
3. Add one line to `tooling/cli-watch/README.md` (near line 229, the existing report-size note) saying the JSON twin is regenerated by `cliwatch scan` and is not tracked.
4. Commit by pathspec in the outer repo only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `git ls-files tooling/cli-watch/reports | grep -c citations.json` prints `0`
- [ ] `git check-ignore -v tooling/cli-watch/reports/x-citations.json` names the new rule
- [ ] Both files still exist on disk (`ls -l tooling/cli-watch/reports/*-citations.json` lists two)
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q tooling/cli-watch/tests` passes with the same count as before the change (record the pre-change count first)
- [ ] `python "{plugin_root}/scripts/generate_backlog_index.py" --config planwise/config.yaml --check` reports no drift
